Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: tjoa ("we", "us", "our") respects your privacy. This policy describes how we collect, use, and protect your information when you use our service.
Privacy.collectDesc: We collect minimal information to provide our service:
Privacy.collectSearch: Search queries you submit to get product and investment recommendations
Privacy.collectPreferences: Preferences you set (price range, quality priority, risk level)
Privacy.collectTechnical: Technical data such as browser type, device type, and language setting
Privacy.collectCookies: Cookies for theme preference and locale setting
Privacy.useRecommendations: Generate personalized product and investment recommendations
Privacy.useImprove: Improve our service and user experience
Privacy.affiliateDesc: We use affiliate links through Adtraction. When you click a link to a retailer, tracking data may be shared with Adtraction and the retailer to attribute the referral. We recommend reviewing the privacy policies of any third-party sites you visit.
Privacy.aiDesc: Our recommendations are generated using AI. Your search queries are sent to our AI provider to generate results. We do not store your queries beyond the duration of your session.
Privacy.rightsDesc: Under GDPR, you have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data. Contact us at the email below for any requests.
Privacy.contactDesc: For privacy-related questions, contact us at: {email}
Privacy.changesDesc: We may update this policy from time to time. Changes will be posted on this page.

Terms.title: Terms of Service

Terms.disclaimerInvestment: Investment recommendations are not financial advice. Always do your own research and consult a financial advisor before making investment decisions. Past performance does not guarantee future results.
Terms.disclaimerProduct: Product recommendations are based on AI analysis and may not reflect the most current pricing or availability. We are not responsible for the accuracy of third-party product information.
Terms.disclaimerGeneral: tjoa is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. We do not guarantee the accuracy, completeness, or reliability of any recommendations.
Terms.affiliateDesc: Some links on this site are affiliate links. We earn a commission when you make a purchase or sign up through these links, at no extra cost to you. This may influence which products or services are recommended.
Terms.liabilityDesc: tjoa and its operators are not liable for any damages arising from the use of our service, including but not limited to financial losses from investment decisions based on our recommendations.
Terms.ipDesc: All content, branding, and code on this site are owned by tjoa. You may not reproduce or redistribute our content without permission.
Terms.changesDesc: We may update these terms at any time. Continued use of the service constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.
Terms.contactDesc: For questions about these terms, contact us at: {email}

Cookies.title: Cookie Policy
Cookies.intro: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. We use cookies to make our site work properly and improve your experience.
Cookies.themeCookie: Theme preference – Remembers your light/dark mode choice (localStorage)
Cookies.localeCookie: Language setting – Remembers your preferred language (cookie)
Cookies.affiliateCookie: Affiliate tracking – When you click an affiliate link, the retailer or Adtraction may set cookies to track the referral
Cookies.thirdPartyDesc: When you click affiliate links to external retailers, those sites may set their own cookies. We have no control over these third-party cookies and recommend reviewing each retailer's cookie policy.
Cookies.controlDesc: You can manage or delete cookies through your browser settings. Note that disabling cookies may affect the functionality of our site (e.g., your theme preference may not be saved).
Cookies.contactDesc: For questions about our use of cookies, contact us at: {email}
